main.description: Initiate a domain transfer from Squarespace to Cloudflare. Creates the com.etzhayyim.apps.dns.transferRequest record on the cfRegistrar sub-DID; the yorishiro-squarespace sqExporter picks it up via Follow and drives the 5-step release workflow. Requires ClassA (3 signers, high) approval before status transitions to approved.

domain.description: FQDN to transfer (e.g. example.com). Must currently be held by Squarespace.

requesterDid.description: Optional: caller DID override. Defaults to the session DID.

approvals.description: ClassA signer DIDs (3 required before sqExporter proceeds). May be provided later via a follow-up approval record.

transferRequestUri.description: AT URI of the created transferRequest record

transferRequestRkey.description: rkey == projectConvoId for the per-transfer project convo

status.description: approved only if 3 ClassA signers were supplied in-band
